entries.name: Bleak Watcher
entries.scope: Thrown damageable Stasis turret with server-held conversion, shared grenade-account payment, shared grenade cooldown/CES overrides, source ownership, initial resistance and Slow/Freeze; explicit calibration and Aspect binding required
acceptance: Physical contact deploys an independent 150 HP construct for 25 seconds, or 30 seconds with Durance at deployment.
Five seeking shots over a calibrated 0.7-second burst every 2 seconds; each shot selects a current visible non-ally within 35 meters.
67% damage resistance ends on the first successful launch; failed selection or rejected launch retains it.
Each real combatant/Guardian hit applies 20/10 Slow for 4.5/2 seconds, extended by 4.5/1.75 with current Durance; 100 stacks invoke shared Freeze.
Destroyed/expired behavior cancels future shots, while already launched projectiles retain parameters and the original Stasis grenade damage credit.
Current construct allegiance follows original owner; same-owner identity survives absence, unrelated missing owners are unknown, and impact-time allies receive no damage or Slow.
Dedicated projectile damage bypasses only native hit cooldown so each rapid hit commits actual HP loss.
Selected template uses 175.6-second base recharge and 0.625 chunk scalar, current Grenade stats, and no energy reset on reselect.
Unknown world results preserve charge payment and committed damage without replaying or applying later Slow.
Base-selection cost conversion consumes the common grenade account without changing base selection/passives or creating a second bank; native projectile damage keeps Bleak Watcher credit.

An explicitly bound source converts only on release after the server-measured hold reaches its positive calibrated threshold; native deployment consumes selected Duskfield energy once, and a repeated release cannot cast again.

An explicitly bound combined Aspect replaces participating grenade base rates with 1/175.6 before current Grenade stat scaling and recipient chunk scalars with .625 before gain scaling. Removing it restores intrinsic values without resetting energy; fixed gains bypass both scalar and gain profiles.

Switching selection preserves the shared balance, splits passive integration and applies the newly selected intrinsic CES. Clearing selection pauses recovery even with the Aspect equipped. Delayed refunds return to the original common account without current CES.
gaps: Server-measured paired input and the explicitly bound Aspect bundle compose conversion with Glacier base-cooldown and chunk-scalar overrides. The verified Compendium source does not provide the hold threshold; .3 seconds is synthetic. Formal subclass/Aspect equipment constraints remain incomplete.
Projectile damage, geometry, deployment/bolt physics and first burst phase require explicit calibration. Test damage 1, first delay .25 and evenly spaced .175 second sub-delays are synthetic.

Per-shot nearest body-anchor targeting, current line of sight, relation checks at impact, fire-time outgoing snapshots and successful nonlethal damage before Slow are explicit Chorus policies requiring original-game evidence.

A friendly physical collision consumes a projectile without damage or Slow. Unknown owner allegiance suppresses targeting and impacts; original-game friendly interception and absent-caster behavior remain unverified.
Durance is sampled at deployment for construct life and at impact for each Slow. Existing deadlines are preserved. Successful launch, not a damage receipt, ends the initial resistance.
Construct visual assets, subclass assembly, HUD, persistence, enhanced abilities and exotic interactions remain incomplete. Content definitions currently live under test resources.

Arcbolt, Duskfield and Bleak Watcher now pay one shared grenade account. Selection sources provide baseline cooldown/CES; clearing pauses recovery and ordinary scaled grants without erasing balance. This is an explicit Chorus policy, not evidence of original-game swap penalties. Dynamic multi-charge capacity, original subclass/grenade swap reductions and persistence migration remain incomplete.

entries.name: Spirit of the Armamentarium
entries.scope: One additional shared grenade charge from a SOURCE bundle, projected from a physical class-item instance; complete-set capacity recomputation on source and selection lifecycle
acceptance: Equipping before or after selecting a grenade creates or resizes one common account without granting the added charge for free.
Two full units permit two actual grenade throws; the third request fails without launching another projectile.
Identical Armamentarium-family sources do not stack; an independent synthetic source composes to three charges and survives removal of the Spirit source.
Atomic replacement sees the final source set, preserving energy above one charge without transient clipping or refill.
Clearing selection pauses recovery. Unequipping while empty still removes excess capacity and energy; reselecting or re-equipping does not restore clipped energy.

Initial account creation gives the base resource initial value only. Equipping preserves absolute energy, shrinking clips excess, and empty-slot source removal still reconciles capacity. These are explicit Chorus policies; original-game equip/swap/death energy penalties have not been calibrated.
Duplicate Armamentarium-family sources use MAX. A distinct synthetic capacity source verifies three charges; it is not a full Touch of Thunder implementation.

SOURCE attach/detach and ability selection reconcile against the complete committed source set. Capacity-changing Buff lifecycles and arbitrary condition changes require their own reconciliation rules; generic automatic projection is not implemented.

entries.name: Box Breathing
entries.scope: Accepted held-aim timer, next-shot snapshot and consumption, per-impact natural weakspot distinction, separate precision shield suppression and numerical aim-assist falloff contribution; normal/enhanced on real owned weapons.
acceptance: Normal 1.5 s and enhanced 1.4 s start at ADS input, independently of ADS transition completion. Only accepted fire restarts the full wait.

The accepted last round captures its bonus before consumption despite magazine reaching zero; body shots and misses consume too. External zero-ammo transitions and refill have explicit cancellation/restart policy.
Compendium policy: default 40 percent weakspot damage; heavy sniper and glaive 30 percent; 10 percent aim-assist falloff distance. Clarity conflict stays visible.
Source held state and prototype tags freeze at fire. Each impact supplies natural weakspot independently from its precision multiplier; release or unequip cannot rewrite an accepted flight.
Shield removes the named precision factor while retaining weakspot damage; synthetic precision region receives no natural-weakspot bonus.
Wait and active buff survive checkpoint restore without restarting; unknown launch/hit outcomes never replay spent ammunition or physical work.
Authenticated held keyboard or rebound mouse input activates the perk; heartbeats do not restart it. Reload recovery accepts a new aim entry and full wait, while release, GUI or focus loss cancels.
gaps: Production weapon, perk and target region catalog; consumer damage/precision/flight/ammo/ADS values and geometry remain synthetic.
Continuous empty-magazine restart, source-attachment and all original-game cancellation/sampling boundaries are explicit Chorus policies, not fully calibrated.
Aim assist is a numeric contribution, not physical magnetism; no actual Divinity bubble producer.
D2 mouse interaction mapping, FOV/animation/HUD, NeoForge graphical acceptance and production loadout integration.
Physical world restart and full exceptional source/target combinations.

entries.name: Ascension
Winter's Shroud (Stasis / Prismatic)
entries.scope: 职业技能接受反应捕获范围Slow、明确战员减伤；任意成功敌方Slow授予三秒额外基础职业回充，按当前接收账户积分；两种子职业与Durance、实际Ascension组合。
acceptance: A paid Marksman cast produces one pulse even with duplicate Aspect sources. Actual target classification selects 60 combatant or 40 Guardian Slow stacks; activity mode selects the 9/8 meter range.
Stasis Guardian timing is 1.5 seconds plus a Durance-specific .5. Combatant duration and extension are required calibration inputs. Prismatic uses 8/1.5 seconds with no Durance extension.
Denied or missing Slow does not grant regeneration. An accepted class use still grants resistance. Rejected abilities and non-class abilities carrying forged input tags do not trigger the Aspect.
Every successful enemy Slow application can qualify. Credit uses the actual applying actor even when shared Slow retains its first applier. Allies and unknown relations do not qualify.

The rate is stat-adjusted baseline plus baseline times 3 in PvE or 1.5 in PvP, for three seconds. Selection changes redirect the bonus; retained accounts keep only their existing baseline policy. Repeated successes refresh the duration and duplicate status identities do not.
Shared Slow converts at 100 stacks through the existing authorized Freeze application. Ascension composes the same Slow, Jolt and Amplified and pays the selected dodge only once.

The 50 percent combatant-only resistance changes real health loss and excludes unclassified and Guardian-tagged attacks. Granted benefits have independent deadlines, persist after source removal, and are removed on death.
Unknown authorization retains prior state and payment and stops without replay. Pure session restoration preserves timers, receipt retention and regeneration integration.
gaps: Stasis combatant Slow 8+4? and resistance 4? seconds are explicitly uncertain in the source. Test 8+4 and 4 seconds remain synthetic. Complete Class-stat recovery curves and gameplay scaling are not calibrated.

Slow jump delta, Freeze/Shatter threshold, radius and Guardian damage are inherited explicit test inputs; original-game spatial timing, refresh/credit, source-detach and death-order edge cases need calibration.

The Aspect is a trusted-host source, with separate Stasis and Prismatic templates. Production subclass/Aspect slots, three-fragment capacity, unlocks and legal loadout constraints are not yet assembled.

All other producer, exotic and fragment combinations, formal effects assets/HUD, physical world persistence and the NeoForge graphical client remain incomplete. Definitions currently live in test resources.
